verdict.rationale: Shortwave supports thread-level team collaboration: private team comments on an email, and @mentioning a teammate gives them access to that email, so a team can plan responses together. There is no evidence of true shared inboxes or shared accounts where everyone sees the same conversation state, and a Front power-user doubted Shortwave could replace Team Inboxes. Missing for 10: documented shared/team inbox or shared-account support, synchronized per-conversation state (assignment, read, done) across teammates, and hands-on corroboration of team inbox workflows.
